summary: The source limits n to five and s to 100, leaving only 505 legal input pairs and at most five constructed digit positions, so honest asymptotic runtime tiers cannot be formed.

replacement_checks.evidence: The remotely accepted implementation rejects an impossible sum in constant work or executes exactly n <= 5 iterations, each containing one minimum, one multiply-add, and one subtraction.

The certificate regression executes both packaged sources on all 505 legal (n, s) pairs and compares them with maxima obtained by independently enumerating every non-negative integer below 10^n once for each n.
